summary: 59-year-old man fell ~50 ft while descending North Maroon Peak near Aspen; Mountain Rescue Aspen deployed via Flight for Life helicopter stabilized him at ~13,500 ft; COARNG HAATS UH-60 Black Hawk (CWO-4 Anders Nielsen, one-wheel landing on a 1x2-ft rock) airlifted him to Aspen airport/hospital with a possible broken jaw and other injuries
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Flight for Life Colorado; COARNG HAATS
